classification: failed bounded cost calibration with actual partial observations

metadataReadback.note: Original metadata returned through tool; no duplicate GET; watch and workflow logs retained

fileAttributionLimits: Only category totals and 20 largest path hashes were exported; exact per-file names/bytes in other cannot be recovered. Source paths are not measured per-file attribution. Logical size is not allocated disk or growth rate.

sourceFindings.finding: hostContext writes five full label-specific inputs per transaction: migration/genesis/state/schedule/trusted; same static source inputs are repeated per label. Exact byte share in other not exported.
sourceFindings.handoff: Share only byte-identical immutable files after exact identity/hash readback; preserve per-transaction target/context, complete actual capture/Validate and independent verifier. No history deletion/hardlinking.

sourceFindings.finding: Original message/timeout/end-height WAL with WriteSync at857/1803 is recovery data, not ordinary debug logging.
SaveBlock/SaveBlockWithExtendedCommit persist block/parts/commit using WriteSync at608. Category total alone does not prove redundant records.

limitations: 2 offers/s is calibration input, not capacity or host pressure level.
Four nodes share one isolated Linux VM; no 4VM/public activation claim.
after5 is censored by storage cap; no paired causal speedup.
Proposal boundary is actual final-block ProcessProposal, not earliest global arrival.
Independent proof completion includes queue, not earliest consensus formation.
Node timer sums are not wall/CPU; progress spans may overlap.
All prior/raw histories and UNKNOWN retained; no retry or deleting data to regain cap.
